text: There is a distinct sense of curiosity within me as I move through these spaces. In the first image, observing a group engrossed in discussion behind glass, I feel like an outsider peering into a world of ideas and collaboration, reflecting on how knowledge is both shared and protected. The second image, with its bold R+D sign and vibrant patterns, draws me in with the promise of innovation and progress. I feel energized and contemplative—eager to absorb, question, and contribute to the ongoing conversation about discovery and change.
